q: Do you charge a call-out fee?
a: We quote a fixed price before work starts, and it includes getting to you. Emergency call-outs start from {callout} and include the first 30 minutes of work. We tell you the call-out fee before the plumber leaves the depot.
Yes. Every plumber and gas fitter on our team is licensed (Lic. 000000) and we carry public liability insurance. Our licence number is on every quote and invoice.
Yes. We answer the phones from {weekendHours} on Saturday and Sunday, and the emergency line is open 24/7, including public holidays.
Yes. We do gas fitting, appliance installs and gas leak checks from {gasFrom}. If you smell gas, leave the house, do not touch any switches and call us on {phone}. In an emergency call 000.
In our service area, a plumber is usually at your door within {arrive} minutes. Closer suburbs are often 30 to 45 minutes. Check your suburb in the service areas section.
Yes. All our work carries a 12-month workmanship guarantee. Parts and hot water systems also carry the manufacturer's warranty, which is often longer.
Yes. We can supply photos, a written report and an itemised invoice for your insurance claim. It is worth checking with your insurer first about any approved providers.
Yes. Pay by card on the day. Afterpay is available on big jobs, and businesses can pay by invoice.
